command:
$ErrorActionPreference="Stop"
$probe=Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP ("hc-settings-probe-"+$env:GITHUB_RUN_ID+".py")
@'
import subprocess,time
from pywinauto import Desktop
p=subprocess.Popen(["cmd","/c","start","","ms-settings:easeofaccess-highcontrast"],shell=False)
time.sleep(4)
wins=Desktop(backend="uia").windows()
targets=[w for w in wins if "설정" in w.window_text() or "Settings" in w.window_text()]
print("SETTINGS_WINDOWS",[(w.window_text(),hex(w.handle)) for w in targets],flush=True)
for w in targets[-2:]:
    try:
        print("WINDOW",w.window_text(),flush=True)
        for e in w.descendants():
            info=e.element_info
            name=(info.name or "").strip()
            aid=(info.automation_id or "").strip()
            ctype=(info.control_type or "").strip()
            if name or aid:
                print("UIA",ctype,repr(name),repr(aid),flush=True)
    except Exception as ex:
        print("DUMP_ERROR",repr(ex),flush=True)
for w in targets:
    try:w.close()
    except Exception:pass

'@ | Set-Content -LiteralPath $probe -Encoding UTF8
& python -X utf8 $probe
$code=$LASTEXITCODE
Remove-Item $probe -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if($code -ne 0){throw "contrast settings UIA probe failed"}
Write-Host "HIGH_CONTRAST_SETTINGS_UIA_PROBE_PASS"
